The attract mode's title sequence introduces the ghosts with name/nickname combinations
The default name/nickname combinations for the ghosts in the original Japanese version are
Oikake - "Akabei"
Machibuse - "Pinky"
Kimagure - "Aosuke"
Otoboke - "Guzuta"
The Japanese version also has a DIP switch for alternate name/nickname combinations for the ghosts
Urchin - "Macky"
Romp - "Micky"
Stylist - "Mucky"
Crybaby - "Mocky"
The name/nickname combinations for the ghosts in the North American version are
Shadow - "Blinky"
Speedy - "Pinky"
Bashful - "Inky"
Pokey - "Clyde"
Unlike the Japanese version, the American version has no DIP switch for alternate ghost names
